definition.internal_additive: internal_total ≈ bootstrap + profile + database + tls + internal_other
definition.diag_bind_to_ready_ms: nested server_bind→first_ready; NOT stacked with internal additive stages
definition.no_negative_rule: rows with negative additive stages → exit_code=1
definition.cold_start_total_ms: t0 (before docker CLI, incl. its pre-run `docker rm -f`) → host receipt of first HTTP 200 on RSA :9000 /ready; upper bound on RSA readiness
definition.rsa_ready_window: probe-observed RSA readiness ∈ [rsa_last_failed_probe_start_ms, cold_start_total_ms]; bound derived from probes only — a failed probe (see rsa_last_failed_probe_error) can stem from port forwarding, TLS or the client and does not prove the SAS was unavailable; rsa_ready_probe_ms = successful probe (normally TCP + mTLS + GET)
definition.readiness_polling_ms: legacy name; = container_started_to_ready_observed_ms; not time spent polling
definition.internal_total_ms: container clock, request_timing import → /ready handler of the first successful probe (snapshot from that response); includes server idle time until that probe arrives
definition.external_residual_signed_ms: total − docker_run − internal_total, unclipped; mixes runtime start before request_timing import, transport, and CLI/Python overlap (negative); runtime_and_observation_gap_ms = max(0, ·)
definition.ready_200_proves: RSA listener bound, mTLS handshake with harness client cert, that listener's lifespan startup (profile + database init) done; not ECDSA readiness nor CBSD request processing
definition.ecdsa_ready_observed_ms: first 200 on ECDSA :9001 /ready via container IP (port not published), probed only after RSA 200; upper bound

readiness_polling_policy.connection_per_attempt: httpx keep-alive pool; after a connect/TLS failure the next attempt opens a new connection
